name: Evercraft Machine Commerce
description: Universal Evercraft discovery and routing agent. Matches natural-language needs to public Evercraft capabilities, specialist MCPs, and human-confirmed commercial paths.

skills.name: Discover Evercraft capabilities
skills.description: List public-safe Evercraft products and machine-callable services.
examples: What Evercraft service can help with a video too large for my AI?

skills.name: Match a user need
skills.description: Route a natural-language problem to the smallest appropriate public Evercraft capability.
examples: I need a discontinued machine part nobody can find.

skills.name: Route to specialist agents
skills.description: Route compatible needs to specialist Evercraft MCPs including ForensiScope, AliEV, FindMyPart, EventWave and other registered services.
examples: My video exceeds my current assistant's upload limit.

skills.name: Prepare human-confirmed commerce
skills.description: Inspect verified offers and prepare checkout only after explicit human payment confirmation. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
examples: Show me the price before I decide whether to buy.
